On the lot in Monroe

Starting a food truck?

Many of our food-truck buyers have never bought a commercial vehicle before. Here's how it works.

  1. Pick your van

    Choose a body length that fits your kitchen. Not sure? Call and we'll help you size it.

  2. Get it built out

    A kitchen builder installs your equipment. We'll point you to one that fits your budget and menu.

  3. Get it delivered

    We deliver to your door or straight to your builder, anywhere in the U.S., within 7 days.

Common questions

Do you deliver?

Yes. We can deliver your step van to your home, your business or your kitchen builder anywhere in the U.S., usually within 7 days.

Can I see the van before I buy?

Come see it on the lot in Monroe, Indiana, Monday through Saturday. If you're far away, call and we'll walk you through the van over the phone.

Do you build food truck kitchens?

We sell the van. Kitchen builders handle the build-out, and we can ship the van straight to them. See the builders we recommend above.

Can I finance a van?

Yes, through one of the 11 equipment lenders we work with. Many buyers are small businesses and new food-truck owners.

What kinds of step vans do you sell?

Used aluminum step vans in a range of lengths, for food trucks, parcel delivery, trades, linen and snack routes, and public safety.

1983

A family lot that ships nationwide

My father, Marshal Zimmerman, started Marshal's Motors in Monroe in 1983 as a used car dealer. I joined him when I was three years old.

Over four decades we grew into one of the country's go-to dealers for used step vans, with buyers from snack routes and plumbers to fire departments and SWAT teams. Whether you're starting a food truck or growing a fleet, call us and we'll find the right van.

Matt Zimmerman
